info.name: HoloNet Galactic Atlas API
info.description:
Star Wars atlas API (Django REST Framework + PostgreSQL).

Run `docker compose up`, then run the whole collection in order: each CRUD folder creates a record, reads, replaces, patches and finally deletes it, so the collection can be re-run.

Detail endpoints accept an **id, slug or name**: `/planets/1/`, `/planets/tatooine/`, `/planets/Yavin IV/`.

item.name: Planets - read
item.description: List, filter and fetch planets by id, slug or name.

item.name: List planets - by region, most populous first
Planets - sub-resources
item.description: People, species and films related to a planet.

exec: pm.test("Luke lives here", () => { pm.expect(body.map(p => p.name)).to.include('Luke Skywalker'); });

item.name: Navigation
item.description: Distances, travel times and nearest neighbours.

exec: pm.test("Sorted by distance", () => { const d = body.map(p => p.grid_distance); pm.expect(d).to.eql([...d].sort((a, b) => a - b)); });

item.name: Planets - CRUD
item.description: Create, replace, patch and delete a planet.

item.name: List people - by homeworld and species
